profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Amazon AWS
profile.summary: I'm currently working as a Software Engineer at AWS. I have worked on cloud infrastructure, API development, and general operational and system maintenance. I'm also learning iOS and Android development on the side. I'm looking forward to the future!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- AWS Marketplace for Machine Learning
- Created a full-stack development tool
- Created a full-stack web application using React, Java, and AWS Services

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: - As part of a team that works on diagnosing the overall health of the Workday cloud platform, my responsibility was to use both Splunk and Wavefront to ultimately create a comprehensive Wavefront dashboard that measured server health.

positions.title: BioSNTR Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Used statistical techniques such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to categorize mouse embryonic data into different stages of embryonic development.
- Created Unity3D application for a graphical representation of the above categorization.
- Presented poster on findings at the South Dakota Established Program to Stimulate Competitive Research (SD EPSCoR) Undergraduate Research Symposium and created a technical report on findings.
